CustomField.label: Location Detail
CustomField.description: A specific room, area, or sub-location within the event venue where this session takes place (e.g. "Room B, Ground Floor", "Main Stage", "Breakout Suite 3"). Supplements the venue-level address held on the parent Event__c record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the specific location within the venue for this session, e.g. "Room B, Ground Floor" or "Main Stage".
